spans.text: "Here must all distrust be left; all cowardice must here be dead."
There is no Hell on earth.
Spirits are buried in the ashes; souls fade into oblivion.
Life is fragile. All it takes is a single bullet, a fire, some terrible luck to be snuffed out.
...You can't scare me.
Walking through an intrusive memory in her mind, Ange stands in the midst of an unfolding disaster.
The shivering young girl can only pray helplessly as she cowers behind a blast containment box.
Ange gazes at the girl as her ears are assaulted by ear-splitting noise around them.
Hey.
Get up.
...I'm telling you to get up.
Amid the commotion, the girl lifts her head and meets Ange's gaze.
In the bottom of her teary eyes lies a whirlpool of heavy darkness.
Ange finds herself tumbling down this endless abyss.
Ange sits up woozily in bed and rubs her temple to clear her head.
At this point, she doesn't even bother to ask what AK-12 is doing in her room. She's got used to it.
Pour me some tea.
...Are you alright?
Only then does Ange notice the grim look on AK-12's face.
What do you mean?
You were moaning and talking in your sleep.
You seemed to be having a nightmare. To be honest, it was really unlike you.
It grossed me out a bit.
...Oh, yeah.
I dreamed that I went back to Statesec. Zelinsky threw me a welcoming banquet.
All the dishes were duck.
You hate duck?
I'd rather eat dirt.
Ange places a hand on the back of her neck as she softly cranes it this way and that, making it click.
AK-12 knows better than to ask any more questions. She simply gets up and makes a cup of very strong tea, which she leaves on the bedside table.
The Commander got in touch.
Tell them we'll be in Alt-Berlin in an hour.
We'll meet at Athena's Owl.
Okay.
Placing her hands on her knees, Ange eyes the tea stalks floating vertically in the tea cup.
Do you think the Earl can be trusted?
Don't tell me you've forgotten—he is a friend of Shaw's. Don't expect me to badmouth him.
I've never liked him.
Our meeting has only confirmed my belief.
We have nothing in common.
But he is helping us, that's a fact.
And he has a point when he says that we don't have a choice, Ange.
Ange takes out the coin from her pocket again. She peers down at it and lets out a snort.
It irks me to be completely at his mercy.
But there really is no other way.
Besides, what he's asking you to do is on your own agenda to begin with.
He just rubbed it in your face to rile you up.
And speaking of your agenda, we had a little chat with the Stasi whelp this morning.
...You mean Light?
Yes.
You don't seem to like him?
Quite the contrary.
Ange flips the coin up and catches it on the back of her hand.
He may be young, but he's level-headed, meticulous, good in a fight, and most importantly, he has impeccable manners.
J is right—he has great potential and a bright future ahead of him. I have a lot of admiration for him.
However?
AK-12 ponders for a moment and points up.
However, I initially held Morridow in exactly the same regard.
Ange lifts her hand and reveals the heads of the coin.
I've never seen a male Nyto.
AK-12 looks a little glum.
You know that's not what I mean.
I'm not saying there must be something wrong with Light, but after what happened in Bremen...
I can't bring myself to trust anyone who popped out of nowhere.
Ange shrugs and pockets the coin again before picking up her cup of tea and taking a sip.
But on the bright side, if he really turns out to be another spy...
Then Paradeus has basically delivered an opening wrapped as a gift straight to you, don't you think?
We'll leave him be for now.
Back to the subject—what have you found out?
Everything the Earl told you checks out.
Shortly after we and the Stasi captured Leone, she was transported to Berlin on official notice.
Once she arrived, she filed an appeal.
The court ruled that she suffered serious mental and physical trauma and exempted her from serving a sentence.
That's how she got off scot-free.
You're going to break your cup.
Where is she now? At a sanatorium?
That's right. She's at Galatea Sanatorium, enjoying the best security and treatment.
For god's sake.
Ange slams the tea cup down onto the table, spilling more tea than she has drunk.
And as RPK has previously mentioned, all data in the Flora Institute has been wiped clean.
We cannot trace them directly, but fortunately, the Bremen government has some public records of several people and organizations who have worked with the Institute in the past.
We've compiled a list.

We're looking for a mysterious figure who's located in Berlin, in a position of considerable power, interested in Leone's research—could be working in some relevant fields themselves, gained prominence in the last two years, and has an otherwise unknown past.
I'm afraid there isn't such a person on our list.
I knew it wouldn't be so simple.
Ange takes the file from AK-12, flips through a few pages half-heartedly, and puts in on the table.
Let's leave that for now. We'll discuss the rest after our meeting with the Commander.
You're really looking forward to it.
Even a fish would poke its head out of water to breathe if there's no oxygen in the water.
Let's go.
Okay~
The Commander, panting heavily, flings the door open and steps onto the wooden floorboards like a high school student who barely makes it into the classroom in time.
This out-of-place newcomer has instantly attracted the attention of the handful of customers and staff inside the bar. The piercing stares are making them a little uncomfortable.
...Ahem, uh... Excuse me.
The Commander enters the bar and carefully closes the door. They scratch their head and apologize for the disturbance.
Slam!
Just then, an even more abrupt noise comes from the back of the bar, drawing away all the hostile glares.
What are you lot looking at?
Swinging her legs up onto the table, the ferocious-looking woman snaps at the other customers.
Realizing she isn't to be messed with, everyone averts their eyes and returns to their own business.
The Commander chuckles to themselves as they walk up to the woman's table, drag over a chair and sits down.
Could you remove your boots from the table, please?
You should learn the proper way of dealing with people like these, Commander.
I simply wished to keep a low profile... Is it really okay for you to be so conspicuous?
Humph... Don't you worry.
Who knows how many of them are actual customers?
Ange snorts and lowers her voice.
They proceed to eye each other wordlessly.
The first to break the awkward silence is the Commander.
Pleased to finally meet you, Captain Tsoi.
I am the AR Team's current commander, also in charge of Area S09 under Griffin's jurisdiction.
Pleased to meet you, Commander. I am Anna Viktorovna Tsoi...but you can just stick to calling me Ange.
Seriously? Do we have to do this?
Well, the ice has to be broken, right?
The Commander chortles.
How about a drink?
No, thanks. I have an upcoming operation, so I shouldn't.
Get them a ginger ale.
Ange snaps her fingers at the waiter and makes an order. Then she lifts her legs off the table.
The Commander watches Ange with a smile.
A little unnerved by the stare, Ange frowns.
What, you don't like ginger ale?
That's not it. I'm just suddenly struck by the fact that we're actually having a conversation face-to-face.
I've never seen this side of you through the communicator.
You talk too much.
Ange crosses her arms and snickers.
So you've talked to DEFY?
Yes, I've also met RPK-16. We talked at the submarine base.
She's working for you now?
More or less. How many Dolls have you brought with you?
Just the AR Team and 404, plus Dandelion, of course.
The Earl has also supplied an additional Squad Griffin.
You've met him?
Not exactly, but we did talk.
How do you find him?
This was the first time I've talked to the Earl ever since I joined Griffin.
He strikes me as a very different man compared to Mr. Kryuger...but is equally bold and driven.
Why has he summoned you to Berlin?
For the same reason you're here.
You know what I'm doing here?
I'm unaware of the specifics.
But I suppose it's about Paradeus.
After all, this is why you've come to Germany in the first place...and I can't exactly pretend I didn't know about your operation in Bremen.
...Humph.
Ange grunts. She drops an ice cube into her empty glass and pours herself some whisky.
He asked you to come to Berlin so that he'll have another moron doing his bidding and risking their life for him.
You seem rather antagonistic towards the Earl.
The Earl and Mr. Kryuger are as different as night and day. If Kryuger is like you, then the Earl is more like me.
We will stop at nothing to achieve our ends, but he's even more ruthless than me.
I suggest that you don't trust him too blindly.
I won't, Ange.
Because we aren't risking our lives for anyone in particular.
Everything we do is for the sake of making this world a better place.
I sure hope so.
What's the situation on your end? Any new breakthroughs?
My endeavors in Bremen proved to be fruitless, and I haven't made much headway here in Berlin either.
I did come into contact with someone from Paradeus, but she escaped.
You mean...the woman called Morridow?
Yes.
Actually...I came across a person by following a lead provided by the Earl.
She bears a remarkable resemblance to Morridow.
What?
Let me finish.
The resemblance is purely physical. From what we can see, it's most probably a different person.
Her name is Machlian, and she's been active in Bohnsdorf—a village nearby—before we captured her.
In case you don't know, do let me warn you.
Morridow is an expert of infiltration and disguise. She's deceived me and Ulrich and even managed to fool DEFY.
Right, that has been accounted for.
Which is why we're still keeping this Machlian under observation... Though Dandelion hasn't noticed anything odd so far.
I'll notify you immediately if there's any new development.
You left her on her own? You're leaving a Nyto unsupervised?
Dandelion and the Squad Griffin are keeping an eye on her. Not to mention she's still unconscious.
Hm... Alright.
But don't hold out too much hope.
I won't.
The Earl told me that William is planning something big in Berlin.
Then he just dumped all the work onto my lap and left, saying he had more important stuff to do.
I hope he didn't mean picking you up from the airport by that.
I doubt that's what he meant.
He never met me in person. He simply issued my orders through the comms.
But...what could William be up to?
I don't know yet.
If that's true, we don't have much time.
I'm well aware of that.
...I'll have Dandelion look into it once I get back.
We may be able to find something useful.
The bait I left in Bremen hasn't been entirely gobbled up yet.
Whoever it is, she's given herself away, and I'll soon have a lead.
Got it.
If you need any help, please get in touch.
I'll come at once.
Ange swirls the whisky around in her glass. After a brief moment of silence, she cracks an unusual smile.
She stands up from her chair and walks over to the Commander.
What, are you going to snap my neck?
The Commander looks up at her in bemusement and asks jokingly.
Ange does not answer. She simply pats the Commander on the shoulder and downs her drink in one go.
Then she slams the glass down next to the Commander's ginger ale.
Phew...
That felt good.
The Commander blinks. They are about to say something but then think better of it.
Ange has been through a lot. The Commander can tell immediately.
And right now, in this unfamiliar country, they're pretty much the only person she can trust.
With this in mind, the Commander smiles and clinks their own ginger ale against Ange's empty glass, then knocks back the ginger ale as well.
Ange has done the best she could. The Commander knows this, and there is nothing more to be said.
Unless they actually want Ange to break their neck.
So we have an agreement?
Yeah, I've taken up enough of your time.
Then I'll be heading back.
If Machlian wakes up, I'll have a lot of questions for her.
Machian...or Morridow?
...Machlian, for the time being.
Humph... Alright.
After seeing off the Commander, Ange shakes her head lightly and taps the comms in her ear.
Enough with the chit-chat, 12.
Get ready. We're paying Leone a visit.
Clink.
A melting ice cube slides down and knocks against the bottom of the glass.
The bar is now empty.
